spec.title: Weak quorum
spec.description: The size of a weak quorum or non-faulty nodes, needed e.g. to disseminate batches

spec.title: Strong quorum
spec.description: The size of a strong quorum, needed for ordering consensus

spec.title: Sequencer core backpressure delay (ms)
spec.description: Delay introduced by the sequencer core being too slow consuming blocks from ordering, in milliseconds

spec.title: Sequencer core buffer size (blocks #)
spec.description: Size of the buffer in the subscription from the orderer to the sequencer core, in blocks

spec.title: Stream Buffer Metrics
spec.description: Size of the stream buffer at various stages

spec.title: Total number of epochs a sequencer was blacklisted in the last 5m
Total number of epochs a sequencer is blacklisted
Total Output Blocks
spec.description: Latest block number ordered and available for the read path. When there is no traffic, a block can be empty.

spec.expr: sum by(namespace, job, node) (daml_sequencer_bftordering_global_ordered_blocks_total{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", node=~"$node"})

spec.title: Total Output Requests
spec.description: Total number of requests ordered and output to the read path.

spec.title: Requests / Block
spec.description: Number of requests per consensus block.

spec.expr: histogram_sum(sum by(namespace, job, node, mode) (rate(daml_sequencer_bftordering_output_block_size_requests{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))) / histogram_count(sum by(namespace, job, node, mode) (rate(daml_sequencer_bftordering_output_block_size_requests{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Output Block Payload Size
spec.description: Size of the payloads of blocks ordered and output to the read path.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile($percentile, sum by(namespace, job, node, mode) (rate(daml_sequencer_bftordering_output_block_size_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Peers count
spec.description: Number of connected and authenticated P2P peers for the selected sequencer. It should be > 2/3 at all times.

spec.title: Total Network Output
spec.description: Total network egress for the currently selected sequencer split by destination.

spec.title: Total Network Input
spec.description: Total network ingress for the currently selected sequencer split by sender.

spec.title: Throughput - blocks/s
spec.description: Rate of blocks ordered and output to the read path.

spec.title: Current Epoch
spec.description: ISS proceeds in epochs with stable leader assignments to "segments" and stable topology (i.e., sequencers can be added and remove only at epoch boundaries and leaders are reassigned to segments also at epoch boundaries). This is the current epoch.

spec.title: PBFT Voting Power %
spec.description: Percentage of votes received by the currently selected sequencer at every major PBFT stage. Should be > 2/3 at all times, else a leader change ("view change" in PBFT parlance) occurs automatically.

spec.title: Non-compliant behaviors
spec.description: Count of non-compliant and possibly byzantine protocol behaviors detected by the currently selected sequencer.

spec.expr: sum by (namespace, job, node) (irate(daml_sequencer_bftordering_security_noncompliant_behavior_total{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Validators
spec.description: Number of active validators

spec.title: Outstanding batch requests
spec.description: Number of batches requested by the availability module and not yet provided.

spec.title: Block proposals requested by consensus
spec.description: Number of proposals requested by consensus.

spec.title: Mempool Size (requests)
spec.description: Size of the incoming requests buffer ("mempool") for the selected sequencer. Its maximum size in bytes and requests count can be currently set via static configuration.

spec.title: Block proposals requested by consensus (batches)
spec.description: Number of batches requested to be proposed in consensus.

spec.title: Epoch Length
spec.description: Size in blocks of the current epoch.

spec.title: Batches being disseminated
spec.description: Number of batches that are being disseminated.

spec.title: Requests being disseminated
spec.description: Number of requests in batches that are being disseminated.

spec.title: Bytes being disseminated
spec.description: Number of payload bytes in requests within batches that are being disseminated.

spec.title: Block delay
spec.description: Wall-clock time of the ordered block being provided to the sequencer minus BFT time of the block

spec.expr: histogram_quantile($percentile, sum by(namespace, job, node, mode) (rate(daml_sequencer_bftordering_output_block_delay_duration_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Blacklisted Sequencers
spec.description: How many epochs a sequencer is blacklisted

spec.title: Requests end-to-end ordering latency
spec.description: Wall-clock duration between the instant a request is received by the CantonBFT orderer and the instant the fully assembled ordered block metadata is stored, just before the request is pushed to the post-ordering stages. Its meaningfulness requires wall-clock synchronization, as not all ordered requests are received and timestamped on this node.

spec.title: Throughput - requests/s
spec.description: Rate of requests ordered and output to the read path.

spec.title: Batches (PoAs) / Block
spec.description: Number of batches (proofs of availability) per consensus block. Note that < 1 average batch per block likely means empty blocks are being created.

spec.expr: histogram_sum(sum by(namespace, job, node, mode) (rate(daml_sequencer_bftordering_output_block_size_batches{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))) / histogram_count(sum by(namespace, job, node, mode) (rate(daml_sequencer_bftordering_output_block_size_batches{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Throughput - batches/s
spec.description: Rate of batches (proofs of availability) ordered and output to the read path.

spec.title: BFT ordering leaders
spec.description: Leadership status of each current topology member: Leader (1) or Non-leader (0). Leaders are allowed to propose blocks for ordering.

spec.title: P2P endpoints status
spec.description: Status of P2P endpoints as seen by each reporting node: Disconnected, Connected (but not yet authenticated), or Authenticated.
